description: This file implements a command-line interactive shell for manipulating kickstart configuration files, including command parsing, auto-completion, and execution of internal commands.

classes.name: InternalCommand
classes.description: Base class for internal shell commands like clear, quit, and show.

classes.name: ClearCommand
classes.description: Internal command to reset the parser's handler to the default version.

classes.name: QuitCommand
classes.description: Internal command to exit the shell.

classes.name: ShowCommand
classes.description: Internal command to display the current parser handler state.

classes.name: KickstartCompleter
classes.description: Auto-completion helper for command and option names in the shell.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the internal command; overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the script, handling argument parsing, setup, and REPL loop.
